title: 3 Cost & weight
description: SYNTHETIC DATA (Europress dataset v1.0.1). Proposals need human approval.

options.content:
### Who pays too much per tonne — and does our scale agree with the truck's?
**€ per tonne** = total collection euros ÷ total tonnes collected. *Times normal* compares it with similar contracts: **1.5** means paying 50 % more.
Bottom table: lifts where **our scale** and the **waste company's truck scale** disagree by more than 10 % — the reason independent weighing matters.

panels.title: € per tonne vs normal, by material

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE material_stream WHEN 'cardboard' THEN 'Cardboard' WHEN 'mixed_waste' THEN 'Mixed waste' WHEN 'plastic_film' THEN 'Plastic film' WHEN 'biowaste' THEN 'Bio waste' WHEN 'paper' THEN 'Paper' WHEN 'mixed_plastic' THEN 'Mixed plastic' ELSE material_stream END AS "Material", count(*) AS "Lifts", round((sum(collection_cost_eur) / NULLIF(sum(mass_kg) / 1000, 0))::numeric) AS "Paid € / t", round(avg(benchmark_eur_per_t)::numeric) AS "Normal € / t", round((sum(collection_cost_eur) / NULLIF(sum(mass_kg) / 1000, 0) / NULLIF(avg(benchmark_eur_per_t), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "Times normal" FROM cp_collections WHERE collection_cost_eur_per_t IS NOT NULL AND customer_name IN ($customer) AND material_stream IN ($material) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 5 DESC

panels.title: Sites that pay the most per tonne

targets.rawSql: SELECT customer_name AS "Customer", site_name AS "Site", CASE material_stream WHEN 'cardboard' THEN 'Cardboard' WHEN 'mixed_waste' THEN 'Mixed waste' WHEN 'plastic_film' THEN 'Plastic film' WHEN 'biowaste' THEN 'Bio waste' WHEN 'paper' THEN 'Paper' WHEN 'mixed_plastic' THEN 'Mixed plastic' ELSE material_stream END AS "Material", count(*) AS "Lifts", round((sum(collection_cost_eur) / NULLIF(sum(mass_kg) / 1000, 0))::numeric) AS "Paid € / t", round((sum(collection_cost_eur) / NULLIF(sum(mass_kg) / 1000, 0) / NULLIF(avg(benchmark_eur_per_t), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "Times normal" FROM cp_collections WHERE collection_cost_eur_per_t IS NOT NULL AND customer_name IN ($customer) AND material_stream IN ($material) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 HAVING count(*) >= 5 ORDER BY 6 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

panels.title: Our scale vs truck scale: lifts that differ by more than 10 %

targets.rawSql: SELECT service_date::date AS "Date", customer_name AS "Customer", operator_name AS "Waste company", round(device_estimated_collected_kg::numeric) AS "Our scale (kg)", round(weighbridge_net_kg::numeric) AS "Truck scale (kg)", round((100.0 * (weighbridge_net_kg - device_estimated_collected_kg) / NULLIF(device_estimated_collected_kg, 0))::numeric) AS "Difference %" FROM cp_collections WHERE weighbridge_net_kg IS NOT NULL AND device_estimated_collected_kg > 200 AND abs(weighbridge_net_kg - device_estimated_collected_kg) > 0.1 * device_estimated_collected_kg AND customer_name IN ($customer) AND material_stream IN ($material) AND $__timeFilter(service_date) ORDER BY abs(weighbridge_net_kg - device_estimated_collected_kg) DESC LIMIT 500
